text:
All tests now pass (16 tests, OK). Fixes in `catalog/`:

- `books.py`: `parse_book` now converts the year to `int`.
- `search.py`: the import pointed at a nonexistent module, so it now imports `normalize` from `catalog.text`.
- `members.py`: `MAX_BORROWED` changed from 3 to 5.
- `fees.py`: the fee is now `days_late * DAILY_FEE`. It was adding instead of multiplying.
- `inventory.py`: `recent(n)` now returns exactly the last `n` events. It was returning `n + 1`.
- `factory.py`: added the missing `Emma` sample book.
